# stats.comparison.RepeatedMeasuresAnova { #spotforecast2_safe.stats.comparison.RepeatedMeasuresAnova }

```python
stats.comparison.RepeatedMeasuresAnova(
    f_statistic,
    p_value,
    df_treatment,
    df_error,
    n_blocks,
    n_treatments,
    ss_treatment,
    ss_block,
    ss_error,
)
```

Result of `repeated_measures_anova()` — one-way RM-ANOVA.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name         | Type             | Description                                                                |
|--------------|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| f_statistic  | [float](`float`) | F statistic of the treatment effect.                                       |
| p_value      | [float](`float`) | Right-tail p-value of ``f_statistic`` under ``F(df_treatment, df_error)``. |
| df_treatment | [int](`int`)     | Treatment degrees of freedom (entries - 1).                                |
| df_error     | [int](`int`)     | Error degrees of freedom ((entries - 1) * (blocks - 1)).                   |
| n_blocks     | [int](`int`)     | Number of blocks (rows; e.g. target days).                                 |
| n_treatments | [int](`int`)     | Number of treatments (columns; e.g. entries).                              |
| ss_treatment | [float](`float`) | Treatment sum of squares.                                                  |
| ss_block     | [float](`float`) | Block sum of squares.                                                      |
| ss_error     | [float](`float`) | Error sum of squares.                                                      |
